thesis: The episode introduces Representative Anthony Gonzalez, a former NFL player and startup COO who now serves on the House Financial Services Committee to regulate Web3 and crypto. The hosts discuss his background as the son of Cuban immigrants and his family's history of exile and return to the United States.
